jogos.significado: The act of provoking, deceiving, or disrupting other players for fun.
jogos.exemplo_correto: That guy ruined the match by trolling his own team.
exemplos_incorretos: I got a really strong troll to beat the final boss.
I need more gold to buy a new troll at the shop.
The server crashed because there was a troll in the network connection.
significados_incorretos: The visual appearance or outfit of a game character.
An advanced strategy used to win professional matches.
A consumable item that instantly restores the player's health.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Troll describes actions meant to intentionally ruin other players' fun, causing frustration in the group.

jogos.significado: A state of irritation or loss of emotional control during a game.
jogos.exemplo_correto: After losing that round he had already won, he went on tilt and stopped playing.
exemplos_incorretos: I pulled off a perfect tilt and took out three enemies at once.
I'm going to gather materials to craft the tilt for my armor.
This game has a really nice tilt, the graphics are amazing.
significados_incorretos: A device used to improve aim in shooter games.
A virtual currency used to buy cosmetics and battle passes.
The act of hiding in a corner of the map waiting for enemies to pass.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Tilt represents a loss of emotional control, which usually hurts the player's performance and the team's experience.

jogos.significado: To advance quickly to attack or reach an objective.
jogos.exemplo_correto: Let's rush bomb site B before they can set up a defense.
exemplos_incorretos: I stayed at base rushing until the match timer ran out.
My account got banned because I used a forbidden rush on the server.
I left my character on rush to gather resources while I had lunch.
significados_incorretos: Leaving a match early because you're too angry.
Critical damage caused by a headshot on the opponent.
A peaceful creature that trades valuable items with players.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Rush is just a fast-advance tactic, which can lead to good or bad results depending on context.

jogos.significado: To repeatedly collect resources, items, or experience.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I'm going to spend the afternoon farming iron to build my base.
exemplos_incorretos: That player is such a farm, he started playing yesterday and knows nothing.
I took a farm to the head and died instantly to the sniper.
The game updated and gave a huge farm to that ability's power.
significados_incorretos: A person who plays on a secondary account to face beginners.
A message repeated many times in chat to annoy moderators.
A programming error that makes the game close by itself unexpectedly.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Farming describes a common, necessary resource-gathering activity, with no positive or negative connotation on its own.

jogos.significado: A reduction in the strength or effectiveness of something in an update.
jogos.exemplo_correto: The weapon I used the most got a huge nerf and is terrible now.
exemplos_incorretos: I used a nerf to increase my race car's speed.
I bought the battle pass just to get the exclusive nerf.
The clan leader gave everyone's account a nerf to help them out.
significados_incorretos: A temporary boost to stats granted by magic potions.
The name given to the starting area where new players spawn.
A secret code typed into the console to enable money cheats.
jogos.impacto_motivo: A nerf weakens something the player liked using, causing frustration and a sense of lost power.

jogos.significado: An improvement applied to a character, item, or ability.
jogos.exemplo_correto: The mage's healing spell got an excellent buff in the latest update.
exemplos_incorretos: My screen froze in the middle of the buff and I got disconnected.
That player is so lazy, always spamming buff in global chat.
Watch out or you'll fall off the cliff and take a fatal buff.
significados_incorretos: A time penalty applied to players who leave competitive matches.
A floating window that shows the machine's performance stats.
Backstory told through collectible books found on the map.
jogos.impacto_motivo: A buff represents an improvement that strengthens the character or ability, which benefits whoever receives it.

jogos.significado: A beginner or inexperienced player.
jogos.exemplo_correto: Don't get mad at him, the guy is still a noob and learning the rules.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a noob sword that beats enemies in one hit.
I need very little experience to level up from noob on my character.
The match ended in a tie because I activated the noob command on the server.
significados_incorretos: Top-tier gear obtained only through legendary quests.
A professional player who gets paid to compete in tournaments.
An advanced AI that manages the map's monsters.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Noob is often used in a derogatory way to point out lack of experience, coming across as criticism or mockery.

jogos.significado: To stay in one spot waiting for opponents.
jogos.exemplo_correto: He'd rather camp at the window with a sniper than help push forward.
exemplos_incorretos: I pressed the button to camp and jump much higher.
I need a camp potion to restore my spent mana.
The game released a new camp with maps inspired by outer space.
significados_incorretos: Buying cosmetics with real money inside the game.
Crafting custom weapons by mixing rare materials.
Surrendering when the match is already completely lost.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Camping is seen as unsportsmanlike, associated with avoiding direct confrontation, which tends to annoy opponents.

jogos.significado: Intense anger caused by the game; to leave a match out of anger.
jogos.exemplo_correto: He died three times in a row to the same trap and rage quit.
exemplos_incorretos: What a cool rage, that monster's design turned out really creative.
I called my friends so we could do a rage of co-op missions.
I got a bonus rage for logging in seven days in a row.
significados_incorretos: Inviting an unknown player to join your guild.
A graphics option that improves water and shadow reflections.
A button combo used to perform a special move.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Rage is tied to intense anger that affects the player's behavior and can lead to abandoning the match.

jogos.significado: A secondary account used by an experienced player.
jogos.exemplo_correto: The match was really unbalanced because there was a smurf on their team.
exemplos_incorretos: I need to farm more smurf to level up my skills.
I activated the smurf shield so I wouldn't take damage from monsters.
This game has a really long smurf, it took me 40 hours to beat.
significados_incorretos: A small blue monster that lives in RPG game forests.
A VR headset used to boost immersion.
A text command used to report toxic behavior.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Smurfing unbalances matches by pitting experienced players against beginners, hurting fair play.

jogos.significado: A decisive play in a difficult situation.
jogos.exemplo_correto: He secured the round with an incredible clutch against three enemies.
exemplos_incorretos: Man, the game is lagging so much, what an unbearable clutch.
I got kicked from the room because they accused me of using a clutch.
I need to drink a clutch of health before the monster attacks me again.
significados_incorretos: Sabotaging your own team to help the enemy side.
The main menu where players choose their characters.
A fast-building technique widely used in survival games.
jogos.impacto_motivo: A clutch celebrates a heroic, decisive play, earning admiration and pride for whoever pulls it off.

jogos.significado: A consumable item that grants temporary effects.
jogos.exemplo_correto: Drink that speed pot so we can escape the monster.
exemplos_incorretos: That player is such a pot, he misses every shot on purpose.
The internet dropped right when I was about to pot the enemy.
The game map is split into four parts and one main pot.
significados_incorretos: A technical glitch that lets you walk through walls without permission.
The supreme leader of an enemy faction in the game's story.
A voice chat room where teams plan their strategy.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Pots give the player a direct benefit, like healing or useful temporary effects, so they're always welcome.

jogos.significado: To create items using materials and recipes.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I'm going to gather wood to craft a new pickaxe.
exemplos_incorretos: The match ended because our captain crafted out due to the lag.
This monster is so fast, it crafts to dodge arrows.
I like playing craft because it's the class with the most health points.
significados_incorretos: Permanently banning a cheater from an online server.
Running in a zigzag pattern to avoid being hit by shots.
A sound effect played when a player achieves victory.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Crafting is just an item-creation mechanic, with no positive or negative emotional weight.

jogos.significado: The character's progression tier.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I finally reached max level and unlocked the last armor set.
exemplos_incorretos: I pressed the level key to open the world map.
My sword broke because its level ran out in battle.
The server is full of level, I can't create my room.
significados_incorretos: The name of the currency used to buy cosmetics in Fortnite.
A physical device used to control flight simulations.
A detailed history of every match played in the season.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Level represents the character's progress and growth, tied to a sense of achievement.

jogos.significado: Energy built up for an ability.
jogos.exemplo_correto: Wait for the cannon's charge to reach 100% before firing the killing shot.
exemplos_incorretos: My account got suspended for 3 days over an illegal charge.
This game has so much charge, the story made me cry at the end.
I invited him to the clan but he said he'd rather play charge.
significados_incorretos: An automatic penalty given by the system to inactive players.
A cosmetic change to the UI for night mode.
Jumping repeatedly to move faster.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Charge is just a mechanic for building up energy for an ability, with no emotional connotation of its own.

jogos.significado: Something upgraded or customized.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I spent all my credits and got my car fully tuned.
exemplos_incorretos: The server got tuned and nobody can log in to play anymore.
I got hit by an arrow and was tuned for ten seconds.
He let out a tuned scream on the mic that almost blew my headset.
significados_incorretos: A situation where the game crashes completely and closes on its own.
A term used to label a beginner player with no skill.
A security mechanism that prevents account theft.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Tuned means something has been upgraded and customized, reflecting the personalization players value.

jogos.significado: A training dummy or test target.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I'm heading to the test range to check this new weapon's damage on the dummy.
exemplos_incorretos: He bought a new dummy to change his character's hair.
We made an excellent dummy and won the regional championship.
The connection has really high dummy, so actions are taking forever.
significados_incorretos: A cheat that lets you see enemies through walls.
A daily reward given to players who complete quests.
An honorary title given to the player with the most eliminations.
jogos.impacto_motivo: A dummy is just a training target used for tests, with no emotional impact on the player.

jogos.significado: Something with an error or unexpected behavior.
jogos.exemplo_correto: This quest is bugged, my character falls through the floor and dies.
exemplos_incorretos: My team played really bugged and that's why we became champions.
I'm going to buy that bugged skin because I love the colors.
I drank a bugged potion that boosted my mana bar.
significados_incorretos: A playstyle focused on being as stealthy and silent as possible.
The ideal keyboard setup recommended by pro players.
The act of donating in-game currency to players in need.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Bugged points to an error that disrupts the gaming experience, causing frustration with system failures.

jogos.significado: To gather ores and underground resources.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I need to go down to the diamond layer to mine.
exemplos_incorretos: I'm going to mine my friends so we can play a match together.
The stage boss started to mine and recovered all his health.
I typed a long message and hit Enter to mine in chat.
significados_incorretos: Creating custom textures for the game's blocks.
Kicking a clan member who hasn't played in a long time.
Improving your internet signal by configuring your router's ports.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Mining is just an underground resource-gathering activity, with no emotional connotation.

jogos.significado: To absorb damage or withstand attacks.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I'll go in front to tank the boss while you attack from range.
exemplos_incorretos: I can't tank this file, the download is too slow.
I bought a wonderful house to tank my rare items.
The match ended because the timer tanked.
significados_incorretos: Crouch-walking so you don't show up on radar.
Using illegal programs that increase shot accuracy.
Making offensive jokes in the match's chat channels.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Tanking reflects the role of protecting the team by absorbing damage, a valued role in group play.

jogos.significado: Random or unknown.
jogos.exemplo_correto: Playing with a random team is hard because nobody communicates.
exemplos_incorretos: My character is really random now, it deals double damage.
I need ten pieces of wood to craft a random.
The match got cancelled because the director had a random technical issue.
significados_incorretos: A person in charge of moderating messages sent in chat.
The ultimate ability with the longest cooldown in the game.
The exact spot where defeated players respawn.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Random simply describes something unpredictable or unknown, with no positive or negative charge.

jogos.significado: An item obtained from or left behind by enemies.
jogos.exemplo_correto: That monster's drop was an incredible legendary sword.
exemplos_incorretos: I stayed drop against the wall waiting for the opponent to pass so I could shoot.
I had to drop my account because I forgot the password.
This map has a really nice drop, full of forests and rivers.
significados_incorretos: A sudden drop in frame rate that causes stuttering.
A command used to reset all default settings.
A playstyle focused on eliminating opponents using only punches.
jogos.impacto_motivo: A drop represents the reward earned from defeating enemies, always welcomed by players.

jogos.significado: Strategic information or communication.
jogos.exemplo_correto: Follow the captain's call so we push the objective together.
exemplos_incorretos: This sword has a huge call that cuts through any armor.
I equipped a new call that turns my character invisible.
The game closed out of nowhere because there was an error in the system's call.
significados_incorretos: A visual modification applied to characters' basic outfits.
A list of penalties handed out to cheaters on public servers.
A consumable item that doubles the experience earned.
jogos.impacto_motivo: A call is just strategic communication between players, with no emotional connotation of its own.

jogos.significado: Someone who tries excessively hard to win.
jogos.exemplo_correto: The match was casual, but there was a tryhard playing like it was a championship final.
exemplos_incorretos: I'm going to use a tryhard to craft diamond tools.
The server crashed because there was a tryhard in the database.
I left my tryhard at max level and earned an achievement.
significados_incorretos: Using glitches to see through walls on the map.
A player who gives up easily and abandons teammates.
Premium in-game currency bought only with credit cards.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Tryhard describes someone who puts in a lot of effort to win, which can be seen neutrally depending on the match's context.

jogos.significado: A computer-controlled player, or a very bad player.
jogos.exemplo_correto: That guy plays like a bot, he walks around staring at the ground.
exemplos_incorretos: I spent my points to buy a healing bot at the shop.
My weapon's bot broke after the fall.
This stage has a really nice bot, with cool lighting effects.
significados_incorretos: A speed boost cars get from using nitro on the tracks.
The official community of developers who create expansions.
A device used to capture and stream the screen in real time.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Bot is used disparagingly to describe weak or unskilled players, functioning almost like an insult.

jogos.significado: The location where players or entities appear.
jogos.exemplo_correto: Enemies are attacking us right after we spawn.
exemplos_incorretos: I activated the spawn to boost my spells' magic damage.
I like playing the spawn class because it runs faster.
My armor broke and I had to spend gold to repair the spawn.
significados_incorretos: A strategy of spending all your money in the first round.
A formal report sent to support against a racist player.
A window showing the tournament's overall leaderboard.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Spawn is just the location where players or entities appear, with no emotional weight attached.

jogos.significado: To intentionally ruin other players' experience.
jogos.exemplo_correto: He joined our world just to grief and blow up our house.
exemplos_incorretos: I'm going to grief this potion to boost my fire resistance.
Griefing is the best way to get gold coins fast.
The game updated and added a griefing option for the graphics.
significados_incorretos: Helping new players by giving out items and teaching mechanics.
Sorting storage chests in alphabetical order.
Finishing a match without taking any damage from enemies.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Griefing involves intentionally harming other players, an attitude seen as harmful and frowned upon by the community.

jogos.significado: The visual appearance of a character or item.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I bought a super cool ninja skin for my character.
exemplos_incorretos: My skin is really low, I need to reset my router.
I took a skin to the head and got eliminated instantly.
The guild needs more skin to be able to declare war.
significados_incorretos: Purposely disconnecting to avoid losing points.
A device that improves a mechanical keyboard's response time.
A passive ability that lets you carry more weight in your inventory.
jogos.impacto_motivo: A skin is just a visual customization, with no impact on gameplay or emotional weight.

jogos.significado: To construct structures or assemble configurations.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I'm going to spend the day building my automatic farm.
exemplos_incorretos: He started building in chat and got muted by the moderator.
The internet dropped and I couldn't build the match in time.
My weapon stopped building because it ran out of ammo.
significados_incorretos: Permanently deleting a game account for inactivity.
Screaming into the mic to distract opponents.
Modifying internal files to cheat in online matches.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Building describes constructing structures or configurations, a common mechanic with no specific emotional connotation.

jogos.significado: The server where the game runs.
jogos.exemplo_correto: The server will go under maintenance tonight for bug fixes.
exemplos_incorretos: I got a gold server after defeating the stage's dragon.
My aim is off because my mouse's server broke.
I'm going to equip this server to move faster in the water.
significados_incorretos: The technical crew in charge of dubbing the characters.
A physical controller with motion sensors used on consoles.
The plot or main story told in the cutscenes.
jogos.impacto_motivo: A server is just the infrastructure the game runs on, with no emotional weight.

jogos.significado: An administrator with special permissions.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I called the server admin to ban the hacker who was ruining the game.
exemplos_incorretos: I forgot to buy admin and ran out of potions during the raid.
My pickaxe broke because I spent all its admin.
I activated admin mode so my car would go faster on the tracks.
significados_incorretos: A super durable block found only in strongholds.
Malicious software used to steal bank account passwords.
Surrendering mid-game when the team loses a member.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Admin just identifies a role with special administrative permissions, with no positive or negative connotation.

jogos.significado: A moderator, or a modification to the game.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I installed a mod that adds new animals and biomes to the game.
exemplos_incorretos: I took a mod to the head from far away and died instantly.
I need ten gold to repair my boot's mod.
The game ended in a tie because the match's mod blew up.
significados_incorretos: Gear that lets you breathe underwater indefinitely.
The official in-game currency used for international live tournaments.
Intentionally losing a match to help a friend.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Mod refers to moderation or game modifications, with no inherent emotional weight.

jogos.significado: To remove a player's access.
jogos.exemplo_correto: Support decided to ban the cheater after reviewing the videos.
exemplos_incorretos: I'm going to ban this item to boost my spell's damage.
I pressed the ban button to skip the intro tutorial.
My team managed to ban the win in the last second.
significados_incorretos: Increasing the maximum number of friends on your list.
Saving your game progress to the cloud so you don't lose data.
Creating a live streaming channel on streaming platforms.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Banning means removing a player's access, usually as punishment, making it restrictive and negative.

jogos.significado: To perform repetitive tasks to progress.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I'll have to grind a lot this weekend to get gold.
exemplos_incorretos: He started grinding on the mic and bothered the whole team.
I got banned for grinding using forbidden programs on my account.
I'm going to grind a really tall wall around my village.
significados_incorretos: Taunting an opponent with provocative messages after beating them.
Setting up your mouse buttons for faster clicks.
Pretending to be a beginner to trick opponents.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Grinding describes repetitive progression tasks that can be tiring, but doesn't carry a fixed negative connotation.

jogos.significado: An obstacle course map.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I spent the afternoon playing a really tough parkour obby on Roblox.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a new obby with the coins I saved up in the game.
The connection dropped because the internet's obby got unstable.
My character took an obby of strength and defeated the villain.

The official virtual currency used to buy cosmetic items.
The name given to the final boss guarding the main castle.

jogos.significado: A waiting area before a match.
jogos.exemplo_correto: We're all gathered in the lobby waiting for the leader to start the game.
exemplos_incorretos: I summoned a really powerful lobby to defend my castle.
My sword broke because I used up all the lobby's durability.
I drank a lobby potion and restored all my health points.

A critical network error that delays commands.
Quickly building walls to protect yourself from gunfire.

jogos.significado: Roblox's virtual currency.

My account went into emotional robux after losing the championship.
The server crashed because the hosting's robux had an error.

The experience level that determines a player's competitive rank.

jogos.significado: Fortnite's virtual currency.

exemplos_incorretos: I'm going to use my V-Bucks to build a stone bridge to the sky.
The game is stuttering because the V-Bucks rate dropped to 15 FPS.

jogos.significado: A win.

jogos.significado: A loss.

I'm going to use the L to run faster and escape the monster.
This L's design turned out amazing, the game has great graphics.

A type of potion that resets the character's stat points.
An admin command used to restart the server's map.
jogos.impacto_motivo: An L represents a loss, tied to frustration and failure in the match.

jogos.significado: A delay in the game's response.
jogos.exemplo_correto: It's impossible to play today because of my connection's lag.
exemplos_incorretos: We secured the round's lag after wiping out the entire enemy team.
I bought a new lag to equip on my diamond armor.
The game's story is great, it has a really emotional lag.
significados_incorretos: A visual cheat that lets you see enemies through walls.
An advanced rush strategy coordinated by the whole team.
A secondary currency used for trading with neutral villages.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Lag ruins the gaming experience by causing delays and freezes, frustrating players.

jogos.significado: The strategy or choice considered most effective.
jogos.exemplo_correto: Running this character composition is the current meta for winning matches.
exemplos_incorretos: My internet is bad, the meta is showing over 300ms.
I took a meta straight to the head and fell eliminated.
I forgot to bring meta to heal myself during the raid.
significados_incorretos: The training area where aim tests take place.
A code error that makes inventory items disappear.
The time it takes for the game to fully load a match.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Meta simply indicates the strategy currently seen as most effective, which can shift over time, with no fixed emotional connotation.

jogos.significado: To reduce the strength, damage, or effectiveness of something in an update.

exemplos_incorretos: I'm going to nerf my character to max level before the final boss.
My internet is so bad it's like someone went to nerf the router.
I managed to nerf three enemies in a row with a single headshot.
significados_incorretos: To significantly improve a weapon's or character's stats.
To restart the server to fix connection issues.
To celebrate excessively after winning a hard match.
jogos.impacto_motivo: To nerf weakens something the player liked using, causing frustration and a sense of lost power, just like the noun nerf.

jogos.significado: The bomb or objective site used in plant/defend game modes.
jogos.exemplo_correto: They're planting at bomb site B, we need to rotate now.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a new bomb to make my character faster.
I took a bomb to the head and got eliminated instantly.
My character leveled up and got an extra bomb of health.
significados_incorretos: A rare cosmetic item bought with premium currency.
A passive ability that increases movement speed.
The name given to the most skilled player on a competitive team.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Bomb is just a tactical objective to plant or defend, with no emotional connotation of its own, depending on the match's context.

jogos.significado: A hostile Minecraft creature that teleports and attacks when looked at directly.
jogos.exemplo_correto: Don't look straight at the Enderman or it'll attack you right away.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a new Enderman to decorate my house in the game.
My connection dropped because there was an Enderman in the network.
I activated Enderman mode to play in duo with my friend.

A tool used to mine blocks faster.
A chat command that hides the player's location.

jogos.significado: A hostile Minecraft creature that explodes when it gets close to the player.
jogos.exemplo_correto: A creeper blew up out of nowhere and destroyed half my house.
exemplos_incorretos: I need a creeper to finish crafting my armor.
I earned extra experience for having a creeper on my team.
The game got the creeper graphic after the update.
significados_incorretos: An allied character that helps the player build structures.
A visual effect that blurs the screen during rain.
A reward given for completing a daily quest.
jogos.impacto_motivo: The creeper is associated with sudden destruction of builds, causing frustration and loss for the player.

jogos.significado: A peaceful Minecraft NPC used for trading items.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I traded emeralds with the villager to get a rare enchantment.
exemplos_incorretos: I got banned because I used a forbidden villager on the server.
My weapon broke because I spent all of its villager.
The stage boss turned into a giant villager.
significados_incorretos: A cheat that lets you duplicate items infinitely.
A special ability that instantly heals the whole team.
A secret location where legendary items appear on the map.
jogos.impacto_motivo: The villager is just a peaceful trading NPC, with no positive or negative emotional weight.

jogos.significado: A defensive creature created by the player to protect an area or village.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I built an iron golem to protect my village from zombies at night.
exemplos_incorretos: I took a golem to the head and got eliminated instantly.
My internet dropped because the server's golem froze.
I bought a new golem at the game's cosmetics shop.
significados_incorretos: A connection error that stops the player from moving.
A consumable item that increases attack speed.
A command used to report toxic players in chat.
jogos.impacto_motivo: The golem offers protection and safety to the player and their base, seen as something beneficial and desirable.

jogos.significado: Away from keyboard; a player inactive during the match.
jogos.exemplo_correto: He went afk in the middle of the match and we played the rest at a numbers disadvantage.
exemplos_incorretos: I bought a really strong afk sword at the game's shop.
I got a legendary afk after defeating the final boss.
The new map has an incredible afk design, full of detail.
significados_incorretos: An ability that increases the character's attack speed.
A rare item obtained only during seasonal events.
A command used to switch teams during a match.
jogos.impacto_motivo: Afk indicates the player's absence during a match, hurting the team and frustrating teammates.

jogos.significado: The character's most powerful, defining ability.
jogos.exemplo_correto: I saved my ult for the right moment and turned the round around by myself.
exemplos_incorretos: My internet dropped right when I was about to use the ult menu.
I bought a new ult to decorate my inventory.
The server restarted because there was an ult in the database.
significados_incorretos: A penalty applied to players who abandon the match.
The place where defeated players respawn on the map.
A virtual currency used to buy battle passes.
jogos.impacto_motivo: The ult represents the peak of the character's power, generating anticipation and satisfaction when used well.
